name: Kae-Dama (Noodle Refill)
description: Add an extra serving of noodles to your remaining soup. A simple noodle refill to enjoy a little more.

name: Aedama (Seasoned Noodle Refill)
description: A seasoned noodle refill to be enjoyed on its own — tossed in a savory tare before adding to your remaining soup. A richer, more flavorful alternative to standard kaedama.
